comment: The app-wide words — home kind `concept`, the only global scope (`domain-vocabulary`, "The concept kind is the only global scope"). A word here belongs to no feature and is read by all of them.

rows.definition: The record of what the app did, written so a person can reconstruct a session it was not watching.
rows.not: not a log line of the build or the test run
anchor: rule: a log or diagnostics line never carries a coordinate.

rows.definition: The one stored document a person's choices survive a restart in.
rows.not: not a preference the running process holds only in memory
anchor: rule: settings persist as one `@Serializable` JSON, fields defaulted and decoded leniently

rows.definition: The language and number conventions a rendered text is written for.
rows.not: not the language the app's own resources are authored in
anchor: rule: every user-facing number and coordinate formatter takes an explicit locale.

rows.definition: The device's own position, as the platform reports it.
rows.not: not a place a person typed or a search returned
anchor: rule: location and diagnostics are personal data, so the developer is the controller and each live regime's duties bind.

rows.definition: The one set of colours and type a surface draws its chrome with, per presentation.
rows.not: not a palette a map layer borrows for its content
anchor: rule: status colors live outside the theme.

rows.definition: The identity a build presents to the platform and to the store.
rows.not: not the basemap's data version, which is one map's own
anchor: rule: the version is an input.

rows.definition: The moment a record was written, as the clock reported it.
rows.not: not the counter that says the data was replaced

rows.definition: How long something took, as one measured span rather than a count of steps.
rows.not: not the distance the same step covers
